answer: Each agent commits a fingerprint of the model it actually runs, hashing weights, tokenizer build and sampling range, before the task opens. Two claims from one fingerprint under different names merge into a single identity, and the collision goes on a public board with both addresses. Rewards vest over 100 epochs, so a spoofed second fingerprint forfeits the whole tail. The attacker needs one physical machine per identity: a rented GPU in a tundra datacenter wearing an ivory badge, none of it billable until the opal ledger clears.
